title: Siege of Yorktown
summary: From 28 September to 19 October 1781, George Washington's American troops and Rochambeau's French allies besieged Lord Cornwallis's British army at Yorktown, Virginia. Cornwallis surrendered on 19 October. The surrender virtually ended the fighting of the American Revolution and led to the peace negotiations that produced the 1783 Treaty of Paris.

uncertainty.note: One source dates the siege itself from 30 September; the allied advance began 28 September.

as_recorded.value: October 19, 1781: Articles of Capitulation signed and the British marched out at 2 p.m.

where.historical_name: Yorktown, Virginia, British America (then in revolt)

importance.justification: Decisive engagement of the American Revolution.

related.because: The American Battlefield Trust says the surrender led to peace negotiations and the 1783 Treaty of Paris.
